start.title: 天からの声
start.text:
声が空に響き渡る。
「ノアよ、箱舟を造りなさい。洪水が来る。」

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The voice fades. But the weight in your chest remains.
[TODO:ja] Genesis 6:22 — Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
[TODO:ja] No answer comes. Only the command remains.

mockery.title: 群衆の声
mockery.text:
村人たちが集まり、笑う。
「舟だと？ここに？お前は狂っている、老人め。」

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Your words only feed their mockery.
[TODO:ja] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah kept building the ark, despite the world's mockery.
[TODO:ja] They turn their backs. You are alone in faith.

building.title: ゴフェルの木とアスファルト
building.text:
何年もの汗。木が割れる。アスファルトが隙間を塞ぐ。
背中が痛むが、箱舟はそびえ立つ。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Rest a while, the work is endless
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Doubt creeps in with the silence.
[TODO:ja] Genesis 6:14-16 — Noah built the ark of cypress wood exactly as God instructed.

ark_done.title: 完成
ark_done.text:
箱舟があなたの前にそびえ立つ。
家族が集まり、木の前に静かに立つ。

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Pride poisons the work. You catch yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Thank God for the strength given
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 6:9 — Noah walked with God and gave Him thanks for every step.

animals.title: 二つずつ
animals.text:
あらゆる地から生き物がやって来る。
子羊の隣にライオン。あなたの足元にワシ。

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Fear blinds you. God sent every one.
[TODO:ja] Genesis 7:8-9 — The animals came to Noah two by two, and he received them.

boarding.title: 扉が閉まる
boarding.text:
家族は中にいる。動物たちは落ち着く。
神ご自身が扉を閉められる。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Run back out to warn them again
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The door is sealed. The choice has been made.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Hold your wife's hand and wait
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 7:16 — The Lord Himself shut the door of the ark behind Noah.

storm.title: 天が開く
storm.text:
これまでに見たことのないような雨が降り注ぐ。
深淵が裂け、世界は水没する。

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The sound swallows your cry.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Trust that God is just and merciful
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 7:23 — Noah trusted God as the flood covered the earth.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Try to pull strangers from the water
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The door is sealed. There is nothing to be done.

inside.title: 四十日間
inside.text:
箱舟は揺れる。動物たちは息をする。
日々はぼやける。残るのは木のきしみだけ。

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 7:24 — Noah cared for his family and the animals through 150 days on the waters.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Sit alone and let despair grow
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The silence presses on you. Faith dims.

dove.title: 鳩が戻る
dove.text:
あなたは鳩を放つ。数時間が過ぎる。
鳩は戻ってくる。そのくちばしにはオリーブの葉。

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Even now, doubt fights to hold you.
[TODO:ja] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned with an olive leaf — a sign of new life.

dry_land.title: 足元の土
dry_land.text:
扉が開く。太陽の光が差し込む。
あなたは暖かく、生きている泥の上に足を踏み出す。

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Rush to claim the new land
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The land was never yours to claim.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Kneel and build an altar to God
choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Genesis 8:20 — Noah's first act on dry land was to build an altar to the Lord.

covenant.title: 虹
covenant.text:
虹が空に架かる。
「二度とない。これはあなたとの契約である。」
